name: now-playing
description: Shows the track playing in Apple Music or Spotify above the prompt, with cover art, play/pause, skip, volume, shuffle and repeat controls, a share-link copy and an Up next pane.

placement.title: Where it shows
placement.description: band: cover and controls above the prompt; footer: the track in the prompt footer's bottom-right labels; both.

size.title: Band size
size.description: large: a framed band with a big cover, the title and artist on their own rows and a wide progress bar (needs 7 rows); compact: two rows with a small cover.

source.title: Player
source.description: Which player to follow: auto picks whichever is playing.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh interval
pollSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, the player is asked what is on while playing (1 to 30). Paused players are asked less often.

volumeStep.title: Volume step
volumeStep.description: How much the vol- and vol+ controls change the volume by (1 to 50).

artwork.title: Cover art
artwork.description: Draw the album cover beside the band in terminals that show pictures (kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm).

queueArtwork.title: Covers in Up next
queueArtwork.description: Draw each queued track's cover in the Up next pane, in terminals that show pictures.

preloadQueue.title: Preload Up next
preloadQueue.description: Read the queue and its covers whenever the track changes, so the pane opens at once.

playlistName.title: Playlist
playlistName.description: The Music playlist the pane's search and Claude's add_tracks tool add songs to; made when missing.

quietWhileWorking.title: Quiet while Claude works
quietWhileWorking.description: Collapse the band to its status row, without controls, while a turn is running.

catalogue.title: Search Apple Music too
catalogue.description: Searches also ask Apple's public catalogue, so tracks you don't own show up with an open-in-Music link.

pushUpdates.title: Instant updates
pushUpdates.description: Listen for Music's and Spotify's own change notifications through a small Swift helper (needs Xcode's command line tools), so the band updates the moment a track changes and polls far less. Off, or without Swift, the band polls as before.

tellClaude.title: Tell Claude what's playing
tellClaude.description: Add the current track to Claude's system prompt, so it knows what you're listening to.
